subject: Request: SDLC integrity & secrets evidence (change flow, Vault rotation) - Stonebridge
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <auditor@safeguard-llp.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, opsec@stonebridge.com
Date: 2028-08-09T14:03:00Z
Subject: SDLC evidence request - change flow, secrets rotation, CI logs

Hi Rafael,

Stonebridge's security assessment team is collecting evidence for our SIG/SOC2 crosswalk. For the SDLC section we need the following artifacts related to code review, CI/CD controls, secrets management, and change control: 

- High-level change approval flow (who approves, criteria for emergency bypass)
- Recent change tickets + proof of PR gating (screenshots or links) for the last 3 months
- CI build logs for a representative week (we only need build start/finish, test results, and who triggered the build)
- Branch protection & required reviews configuration (policy export or screenshots)
- Vault rotation matrix showing rotation frequency, last rotated dates, and owner (CSV is fine)
- Evidence of ephemeral credential usage (impersonation/short-lived tokens) and the mechanism used to issue them

Can you provide an index document with links to each artifact and a small narrative (1–2 paragraphs) explaining how Redwood enforces PR gating and secrets rotation? Preferably within 3 business days. Attachment: request_checklist.docx

Thanks,
Sophie Lang
Senior Assessor, Safeguard LLP
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lang <auditor@safeguard-llp.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-08-09T17:25:00Z
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request - change flow, secrets rotation, CI logs

Sophie — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble everything you asked for. High level plan: 

1) Today: I'll send an SDLC evidence index PDF that maps your items to files and locations (Drive / secure share).
2) Tomorrow morning: Marissa will export CI build logs and screenshots of PR gating.
3) Karthik will export the Vault rotation matrix and a short CSV.
4) By Friday EOD: we will upload the artifacts to the shared Drive link and provide a narrated summary (2–3 paragraphs) mapping to SIG/SOC2 controls.

Notes / quick answers inline: 
- PR gating: mandatory branch protection + required reviewers; merges blocked until CI passes unless escalated via documented emergency process.
- Secrets: we use HashiCorp Vault (customer-scope secrets in dedicated namespaces) with automated rotation for service credentials; ephemeral tokens via short-lived AppRole sessions and OIDC for human access.

I'll attach the evidence index in my next note. Looping Marissa and Karthik to pick up the artifacts.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lang <auditor@safeguard-llp.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-08-10T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request - CI logs and PR gating exports

Hi Sophie,

Attached: ci-build-logs-20280803.zip (contains 7 days of anonymized build metadata), and a small PDF with screenshots of branch protection settings for the primary repo. Summary: 

- Build logs: we export build metadata from our CI (start/end timestamps, job outcome, triggered_by field). We scrub PII and token values before sharing. Example log entries are in build-20280803.csv inside the zip.
- PR gating: required status checks (lint, unit, smoke) + two required reviewers for protected branches; enforcement is via repo policy and automated blocking merges until checks pass.
- Emergency bypass: documented in our change control runbook — an approved emergency merge requires two on-call approvals + an entry in the emergency-change ticket with post-rollback plan.

I also attached a short README inside the zip describing how to interpret the logs. If you need raw pipeline traces (stack traces for failed jobs) we can provide under an NDA scope, but not in the initial bundle.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
SRE / Build Reliability
Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): ci-build-logs-20280803.zip, branch-protection-screenshots.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lang <auditor@safeguard-llp.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Fwd: SDLC evidence request - Vault rotation matrix and rotation proof

Forwarding the Vault artifacts. See attached: vault-rotation-matrix-2028-06.csv (owner, secret-path, rotation-frequency, last-rotated, next-rotation-due).

Short notes for the assessor: 
- Vault configuration: dedicated namespaces per environment (prod/stage/dev). Service credentials use automated rotation via the credentials-rotator service (runs daily and rotates service passwords on a 30/90-day cadence depending on sensitivity).
- Ephemeral tokens: AppRole sessions are minted with TTLs <= 1h for automation; human OIDC sessions default to 15m short-lived tokens plus refresh via MFA.
- Change provenance: rotation jobs publish rotation events to an append-only audit log (exported view included as audit-rotation-sample.csv in the Drive link).

Rafael/Marissa — I also uploaded the SDLC evidence index (sdlc-evidence-index.pdf) to the Drive link Sophie referenced: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSDLC-EVIDENCE. That index maps each requirement to the specific file in the Drive and notes the applicable SIG controls.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Secrets & Key Management)
Redwood Inference
Attachment: vault-rotation-matrix-2028-06.csv
